items.title: Slipknot Confirm Sid Wilson Fired After 28 Years
items.summary: Slipknot have finally confirmed turntablist #0 is out of the band after 28 years. Two weeks ago, TMZ reported that the metal group’s original DJ, Sid Wilson, was notified that he’d been "permanently kicked out." Now the pink slip appears official. The post Slipknot Confirm Sid Wilson Fired After 28 Years appeared first on Stereogum.

items.title: Twisted Teens – “toe”
items.summary: New Orleans duo Twisted Teens have become one of the breakout underground rock bands of the year thanks to two albums' worth of ragged, energetic, extremely catchy Southern-fried punk rock. They recently announced they'll have a third LP out this year to go along with Blame The Clown and Florida Water Blues, a breakup album they've compared to Blood On The Tracks.

items.title: The Cradle Announce New Album Get Yourself A Man & Other Love Songs: Hear “Human Nature”
items.summary: Last year, Paco Cathcart released their first album under their name after over 50 albums as the Cradle. But now the singer-songwriter is back to using the moniker to announce a new LP called Get Yourself A Man & Other Love Songs, arriving this fall. The post The Cradle Announce New Album <em>Get Yourself A Man & Other Love Songs</em>: Hear “Human Nature” appeared first on Stereogum.
